characters.name: Ollie
characters.description: Blue/Orange Contrast: Has orange fur and wears a blue (and white) striped shirt. Bookworm: He enjoys reading. Butt-Monkey: Poor Ollie has to put up with Moon's sometimes reckless decisions (this gets toned down in Season 2). Suffers a lot of slapstick, and gets the short end of the stick when it comes to the mishaps during the trips. Catchphrase: "When you have a brainstorm, I get dragged off somewhere." He stops saying this in Season 2. Character Development: He starts becoming more tolerant of Moon's brainstorms in Season 2, and, while still slightly hesitant, is much more eager to tag along with her than in the first season. He also overcomes his fear of water in "Fearless in Fiji."

characters.name: Moon
characters.description: Action Girl: She’s always up for an adventure and quite the risk-taker. Beware the Silly Ones: She’s normally quite crazy and perky, but when the situation calls for it she can be practical and no-nonsense. Big Eater: She has quite an appetite for different foods, and can eat large quantities of it. Break the Cutie: She normally sees the positive side of things, but she can become quite despaired if her urges or ideas go wrong. Butt-Monkey: Not as bad as Ollie but she still suffers from bad luck for the sake of comedy at times.
